summary: The game's front door: a title screen with new game, continue, load, settings, credits and quit; one SceneFlow autoload that owns every transition between title, expedition and battle with a fade and a threaded loading veil; a pause menu on Escape; and a suite that walks the whole round trip through the live bridge.

coordination.notes: game/project.godot takes an append at the END of [autoload] plus the run/main_scene line, per the keep-both-tails rule for parallel lanes. expedition_prototype.gd and battle_prototype.gd each take exactly ONE changed line -- the get_tree().change_scene_to_file call becomes the SceneFlow call that owns that transition -- because P7 owns the former and P6 the latter this round; a conflict there is a keep-both tail on one line. campaign_session.gd is extended, not forked: describe_slot gains the active_location_id a save screen has to show, and continue_newest is split so that continue_slot(slot) is the one load path and continue_newest picks a slot and delegates to it. No second save reader enters the tree.
